stokPos.aciklama: Products and barcodes, stock per branch, the till screen, non-fiscal receipts and end-of-day reports in one place.
stokPos.aciklamaYonetici: View a customer's inventory and sales records read-only (for support).
stokPos.aciklamaKasiyer: Till screen: scan or search for a product, take payment and print the receipt.

hareketAciklama.giris: Goods received from a supplier: quantity and (optionally) unit cost excl. VAT. The cost becomes the product's latest purchase price.
hareketAciklama.cikis: Stock out other than a sale (e.g. own use, samples).
hareketAciklama.duzeltme: The quantity you enter becomes the new stock at this location (the difference is recorded as a movement).

okut.izinYok: Camera permission was denied. Type the code or use a barcode scanner.
okut.desteklenmiyor: This browser cannot read barcodes with the camera. Type the code or use a USB/Bluetooth scanner (it types like a keyboard).

kasa.acAciklama: The {{konum}} till is closed. Enter the opening cash and open the till; sales are recorded in this session.
kasa.araIpucu: Scan a barcode or type a product name
kasa.agYok: No connection, the sale was not saved. The basket is kept on this device; try again when you are back online (the sale will not be recorded twice).
kasa.geriYuklendi: The previous basket was restored from this device.
kasa.sepetBos: The basket is empty. Scan or pick a product.
kasa.kartNotu: Card payment is recorded only; there is no card terminal integration — charge the amount on your terminal separately.
kasa.urunYok: No products. Add them in the Products section.
kasa.iptalOnay: Void this sale? Stock is added back and the sale is excluded from the day's totals.

alici.kvkk: Customer details are kept only for invoices and sales records; you can delete them at any time.

fatura.uyari: This is an informational PDF invoice; it does not replace an e-Invoice / e-Archive invoice (e-Archive integration later).

fis.maliDegil: THIS IS NOT A FISCAL RECEIPT. It does not replace a fiscal cash register receipt or e-Archive document.

z.maliDegil: Not fiscal: it does not replace a fiscal cash register Z report.

urun.csvIpucu: CSV headers: barkod; sku; ad; kategori; birim; alis_fiyati; satis_fiyati; kdv_orani; kritik_esik; stok. A product with a matching barcode (or SKU) is updated; the stok column sets stock at the default branch.
urun.silOnay: Delete “{{ad}}”? If it has sales or stock history it is made inactive instead.
urun.pasifYapildi: The product has history, so it was made inactive.
urun.iceAktarildi: Imported: {{eklenen}} new, {{guncellenen}} updated, {{hata}} rows with errors.
urun.barkodIpucu: EAN-13/EAN-8 or any code. Leave empty to generate an in-store EAN-13.
urun.alisIpucu: Unit cost excl. VAT; updated on stock-in.
urun.kritikIpucu: You get one alert when total stock falls to this level.
urun.varyantIpucu: Each size/colour becomes its own line with its own barcode and stock.
urun.menudenAktarildi: Imported from the QR menu: {{eklenen}} new, {{guncellenen}} updated.
urun.menuAciklama: Menu/catalogue products are added as linked items (no second catalogue). Prepared items come with stock tracking off; if you turn it on, they show as “sold out” on the QR menu when stock runs out.
urun.menuYok: There is no QR menu / catalogue store in this account.

etiket.ipucu: {{sayi}} labels, {{sayfa}} pages. When printing choose margins “none” and scale 100%.

stok.urunAra: Search a product or scan a barcode (Enter)
stok.maliyetGuncelle: Use the entered unit cost as the product's purchase price

sayim.aciklama: Start a stocktake, scan items (each scan +1) or type the quantity; on approval the difference is recorded as a stock movement.
sayim.okutIpucu: Scan a barcode (Enter) — each scan adds 1
sayim.onaylandi: Approved: {{kalem}} items, {{farkli}} with differences (+{{arti}} / −{{eksi}}), value difference {{deger}}.
sayim.sifirla: Set stock to zero for items not counted at this branch
sayim.onaylaOnay: Approve the stocktake? Differences are recorded as stock movements and cannot be undone.

rapor.gunSecenek: Not sold in the last {{sayi}} days
rapor.karNotu: Profit = net sales (excl. VAT, after refunds) − unit cost at the time of sale × net quantity.
rapor.sahaNotu: Materials deducted from stock by field service work orders (reversals subtracted); cost at the purchase price when deducted.

ayar.yasal: In Turkey the legal document for retail sales is a fiscal cash register (ÖKC) receipt or an e-Archive invoice. This module's receipt, end-of-day report and PDF invoice are informational and do not replace them. Card payments are recorded only.
ayar.fisNotuIpucu: E.g. a thank-you note or returns policy. The “not a fiscal receipt” notice is always printed as well.
ayar.kdvIpucu: Separate with commas. Leave empty for the current Turkish rates: {{varsayilan}}.
ayar.kasaIndirimIpucu: Only for team members with the till permission; stock managers are unlimited.
ayar.eksiStok: Allow negative stock (sell even when stock is insufficient)
ayar.kritikBildirim: Send a notification on low stock
ayar.qrEsitle: Linked QR menu items show as “sold out” when stock runs out

hata.genel: Something went wrong. Please try again.
hata.cok_hizli: Too many requests; wait a few seconds.
hata.yetki_yok: You are not allowed to do this.
hata.hesap_izni_yok: Your team role does not allow this section.
hata.modul_kapali: The inventory and POS module is off for this account.
hata.aralik_disi: The value is out of range.
hata.miktar_tam_olmali: Quantity must be a whole number for this unit.
hata.barkod_kontrol_hanesi: The barcode check digit is wrong (should be {{beklenen}}).
hata.barkod_gecersiz: A barcode may contain only letters, digits and - . _ / + (max 32).
hata.barkod_kullaniliyor: This barcode is used by another product.
hata.sku_kullaniliyor: This SKU is used by another product.
hata.kdv_orani_gecersiz: The VAT rate must be one of the rates in settings.
hata.birim_degismez: A product with fractional stock cannot be changed to a whole-number unit.
hata.sube_siniri: Branch limit reached ({{sinir}}). Contact your agency for more.
hata.kasa_kullanici_siniri: The monthly till user limit has been reached ({{sinir}}).
hata.konum_kapatilamaz: The default branch or a branch with an open till cannot be deactivated.
hata.kasa_kapali: The till is closed. Open it first.
hata.kasa_zaten_acik: A till is already open at this branch.
hata.cok_kalem: Too many lines in the basket.
hata.indirim_fazla: The discount cannot exceed the amount.
hata.indirim_limiti: Your discount limit is {{limit}}%. Ask a manager for more.
hata.toplam_degisti: Prices have changed; check the new total and try again.
hata.odeme_fazla: Card and transfer amounts exceed the total.
hata.nakit_yetersiz: Cash received is less than the amount due.
hata.iade_fazla: The refund quantity exceeds what remains.
hata.iade_yetkisi_yok: You are not allowed to refund or void.
hata.iptal_edilemez: This sale cannot be voided (refunded or already voided).
hata.iptal_suresi_gecti: Voiding is only possible in the same till session; use a refund instead.
hata.sayim_zaten_acik: There is already an open stocktake at this branch.
hata.stok_takibi_yok: Stock tracking is off for this product.
hata.ayni_konum: Source and target branch must differ.
hata.vergi_no_gecersiz: The tax ID must have 10 or 11 digits.
hata.fatura_zaten_var: An invoice was already issued for this sale.
hata.fatura_yok: There is no invoice for this sale.
hata.dosya_buyuk: The file is too large (max {{en_cok_kb}} KB).
hata.baslik_eksik: The CSV must have at least the “ad” and “satis_fiyati” headers.
hata.csv_bozuk: The CSV file could not be read.
hata.cakisma: The record changed at the same time; try again.
hata.kdv_oranlari_gecersiz: VAT rates must be 1–8 whole numbers between 0 and 100.
hata.aralik_gecersiz: The end cannot be before the start.
hata.aralik_cok_uzun: The range can be at most one year.
hata.iptal_satis: A voided sale cannot be invoiced.
hata.govde_gecersiz: The request could not be read.
hata.hesap_uyesi_degil: You are not a member of this account's team.
hata.istemci_kimligi_gerekli: The offline sale has no ID.
hata.oturum_gerekli: The offline sale has no till session.
hata.oturum_konum_uyusmuyor: The sale's till session does not belong to this branch.
hata.istemci_zamani_gecersiz: Could not read the sale time.

kuyruk.cevrimdisiBilgi: Offline: sales are queued on this device and sent in order when the connection returns. Keep this tab open — the till page cannot be opened from scratch without internet.
kuyruk.katalogYok: No offline catalogue on this device; only the products on screen can be sold.
kuyruk.eksiUyari: Sale queued; based on the last sync, stock goes negative: {{urunler}}.
kuyruk.sonEsitlemeyeGore: (based on stock at the last sync)
kuyruk.musteriNotu: Customer details are not stored on this device or added to offline sales; issue an invoice once you are back online.
kuyruk.bellekte: No persistent storage in this browser: the queue lives only in this tab's memory, do not reload the page.
kuyruk.iptalOnay: Remove {{no}} from the queue? The sale will never reach the server; correct the collected amount separately.
kuyruk.ayrilOnay: There are {{sayi}} sale(s) in the queue; they are not synced while the till screen is closed. Leave anyway?
